topic: Mike tries to find his own phone number on his old roofing site
hook: Never hide your number like Mike did. It cost him a roofing job.
caption:
Comment WEBSITE and I'll check where your number sits on your site, free.

Mike runs Northpeak Roofing. On Monday he tried to call himself from his own website, the way a customer would. 3 scrolls. Then he found it, in the footer, in tiny gray type.

If it takes the owner that long, the homeowner in Denver with a bucket under the leak is already calling somebody else.

Send this to a contractor who never tried calling himself.

#roofing #contractor #smallbusiness

scenes.caption: Mike tries to call his own business. From his own website.
Found it. In the footer. In tiny type.

scenes.say: Even I'd call the other guy.

scenes.caption: Put your number at the top. Make it one tap.
